title: Turn Over & Rotate
description: Diagrams turn and rotate the paper between folds.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.instruction: Fold the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.
tips: Crease firmly so the triangle stays closed.

steps.title: Turn over
steps.instruction: Flip the triangle over, left to right.
tips: The circle-arrow symbol means turn over.

steps.title: Rotate
steps.instruction: Turn the triangle so the long edge is at the bottom.
tips: Rotating keeps the same side facing you.
steps.check: The long edge is at the bottom.
